s1.expectation: I think the app is starting up.
s1.cue: Only the green owl face; there are no words.

first_pass.why: There is not a single word, so I cannot tell whether it is loading, stuck, or waiting for me.
first_pass.solution: A line of text such as 'Loading Duolingo...'.

test_cases.action: Close the app completely (swipe it away or press the home button and relaunch from the phone), open Duolingo again, and watch the very first screen. Say what you see and whether you can tell what is happening.
test_cases.real_if: you cannot tell what is happening on the first screen
test_cases.not_real_if: you can tell the app is starting
test_cases.what_happened: I closed the app and opened it again. For a few seconds there was only the green owl face on a green background, with no words, then the lesson page appeared. I knew the app was starting only because I had opened it myself a moment before; the screen said nothing.

s1.closing_comment: When I open the app myself I know it is starting, but the owl alone would not tell me that if I came back to it after an interruption.

s2.expectation: I am choosing which language to learn.
s2.cue: The question 'What would you like to learn?' and the list of languages.

first_pass.why: The question at the top says exactly what this screen is for, in plain words.

s3.expectation: Perhaps the main page, but it is almost empty.
s3.cue: The pink band 'SECTION 1, UNIT 1 Hot Cross Buns - Zari's version' and the lit-up house at the bottom.

first_pass.why: The band names a song, not a place, the rest of the page is blank, and the bottom pictures have no words.
first_pass.solution: Put a plain title such as 'Home' or 'Your lessons' at the top, and a word under each picture along the bottom.

test_cases.action: Open the app and let the first screen settle. Look at it for a few seconds without scrolling and say where you think you are. Then tap the second picture in the row along the bottom, then tap the first picture again, and say whether you can tell you are back where you started.
test_cases.real_if: you cannot name the place, or cannot tell you are back
test_cases.not_real_if: you can name it and recognise it when you come back
test_cases.what_happened: The first screen settled on the page with the green band 'SECTION 1, UNIT 1 Order at a café' and the house lit up at the bottom. I would call it the main lesson page, but only by guessing. I tapped the second picture and got a page titled 'Quests'; I tapped the first picture and the same green band and path came back with the house lit again, so I could tell I was back where I started.

s3.closing_comment: I could recognise this page when I came back to it by the same green band and lit house, but it still has no name of its own; I can only call it 'the page with the lessons'.

s4.expectation: Something has dropped down from the flag at the top; it seems to be about which course I am taking.
s4.cue: 'Your Spanish Score is 1' and the heading 'New Courses'; the rest of the page is greyed out.

first_pass.why: There is no title saying what this panel is; 'New Courses' is halfway down and names only part of it, and I would not know how I got here if I looked away.
first_pass.solution: Give the panel a heading at the very top, such as 'Your courses', and a plain 'Close' button.

test_cases.action: On the first screen, tap the small flag at the top-left. Say where you think you are now. Then tap the flag again and say whether you are back where you were.
test_cases.real_if: you cannot say what opened or where you are
test_cases.not_real_if: you can say what opened and that the flag took you back
test_cases.what_happened: I tapped the flag and a panel dropped down showing 'Spanish', 'Your Spanish Score is 1' and 'New Courses', with the page behind greyed out. Because I had just touched the flag, I could see the panel belonged to it and was about my Spanish course. I tapped the flag again and the panel went away, leaving the lesson page as before.

s4.closing_comment: Seeing the panel drop from the flag as I touched it told me what it was, and the flag closed it again; but it has no title, so after looking away I would still be lost.

t18.action_sentence: You stayed on this screen and scrolled up.
t18.expectation: The second picture shows the main page with the lessons, not the Streak page I was on.

first_pass.why: I was told I only scrolled, yet the 'Streak' title and the calendar have gone and a different page is showing; I would think I had pressed something by mistake.

test_cases.action: On the first screen tap the flame with a number at the top. On the page that opens, scroll up and down as far as it goes several times, then swipe sideways and back. After each move, without looking back, say where you are. Finally tap the X at the top-left.
test_cases.real_if: the name at the top leaves you, or the page changes under you while you only scroll
test_cases.not_real_if: the name stays with you through every scroll
test_cases.what_happened: I tapped the flame and a page titled 'Streak' opened, with 'PERSONAL' marked and the September calendar. I scrolled down and up several times and each time 'Streak' stayed at the top and I was on the same page. Swiping sideways moved me to 'FRIENDS', still under 'Streak', and swiping back returned me to 'PERSONAL'. Scrolling up hard at the top did not take me anywhere else. The cross took me back to the lesson page.

t18.closing_comment: On the phone, scrolling the Streak page up and down, and even pulling at the top, never took me anywhere else; 'Streak' stayed at the top every time, so my complaint about the page changing under me does not hold.
